title.zh: 排序算法 · 冒泡、归并与快排
title.en: Sorting algorithms · bubble, merge and quicksort

description.zh: 同样把一堆数排好，冒泡排序靠相邻两两交换、要比较约 n² 次；归并排序把数组对半切开、分别排好再像拉链一样合并，只需约 n log₂ n 次——差距不在写得勤快，而在比较次数随数据量增长的形状。
description.en: Both get a list in order, but bubble sort swaps neighbours and needs about n² comparisons, while merge sort halves the list, sorts each half and zips them together in about n log₂ n — the difference is not effort but how the comparison count grows with the amount of data.

title.zh: 大 O 记号 · 增长的形状
title.en: Big O notation · the shape of growth

description.zh: 大 O 只说算法的工作量随输入规模 n 怎样增长，去掉了常数系数：O(n²) 的算法 n 翻倍时工作量约翻 4 倍，O(n log n) 只约翻 2 倍多；系数仍然存在，所以 n 小时“形状差”的算法也可能更快，但 n 足够大时形状一定胜出。
description.en: Big O describes only how an algorithm’s work grows with the input size n, dropping constant factors: doubling n roughly quadruples the work of an O(n²) algorithm but only slightly more than doubles an O(n log n) one; the constants are still real, so for small n a worse-shaped algorithm can win, but for large enough n the shape always decides.

label.en: Merge sort is divide and conquer

reason.zh: 归并把数组从中间切开、递归排好两半再合并；每层合并约 n 次比较、共约 log₂ n 层，相乘得 n log₂ n——分治的账在这里算得最清楚。
reason.en: Merge sort splits the array in the middle, recursively sorts both halves and merges them; each level of merging costs about n comparisons over about log₂ n levels, giving n log₂ n — divide and conquer at its clearest.

label.zh: 大 O 是从计数里拟合出来的
label.en: Big O is fitted from the counts

reason.zh: 把 n 从 50 翻倍到 800，真数每种排序的比较次数：n² 家族每翻一倍约 ×4，n log n 家族约 ×2.2——大 O 就是这张实测表的形状。
reason.en: Doubling n from 50 to 800 and actually counting each sort’s comparisons, the n² family grows about ×4 per doubling and the n log n family about ×2.2 — Big O is the shape of that measured table.

label.zh: 双对数图上的斜率就是次数
label.en: On log–log axes the slope is the exponent

reason.zh: 横纵都取 log₂ 画比较次数，n² 的点排成斜率 2 的直线，n 的点斜率 1；读斜率就读出了增长的次数。
reason.en: Plot comparison counts with log₂ on both axes and the n² points line up with slope 2, linear ones with slope 1; reading the slope reads off the growth exponent.

reason.zh: n 个元素能对半切约 log₂ n 次，所以分治算法里总冒出 log n；n 从 1000 到 100 万，log₂ n 只从约 10 涨到约 20。
reason.en: n items can be halved about log₂ n times, which is why log n keeps appearing in divide-and-conquer algorithms; as n goes from a thousand to a million, log₂ n only rises from about 10 to about 20.

question.zh: 同一副乱牌，为什么归并排序比冒泡排序快那么多？
question.en: Given the same shuffled cards, why is merge sort so much faster than bubble sort?

ask.zh: 两种排序各要比较多少次？n 翻一倍时各增加多少？
ask.en: How many comparisons does each need, and how do they grow when n doubles?

ask.zh: n² 和 n log n 在 n = 1000 时差多少倍？
ask.en: How far apart are n² and n log n when n = 1000?

reveal.zh: 快慢由比较次数的增长形状决定：冒泡约 n²，归并约 n log₂ n。n = 1000 时前者约一百万次，后者约一万次，相差近百倍，而且 n 越大差得越多。
reveal.en: Speed is set by how the comparison count grows: bubble sort needs about n², merge sort about n log₂ n. At n = 1000 that is about a million versus about ten thousand — nearly a hundredfold — and the gap widens as n grows.
